data.sql:
$select=year,quarter,avg(fare) AS avg_fare,sum(passengers) AS passengers_per_day
$where=(airport_1='BOS' AND airport_2='LAX') OR (airport_1='LAX' AND airport_2='BOS')
$group=year,quarter
$order=year DESC,quarter DESC
$limit=8

sources.name: DOT Consumer Airfare Report Table 1a, airport pairs (SODA tfrh-tu9e, ad-hoc Live Signal)

assumptions: Ad-hoc SoQL over tfrh-tu9e written by the agent; the query is shown with the result.
Numeric values are rounded to 2 decimals (4 decimals below 1) as returned to the agent.
Only the first 8 rows were returned (limit 8); more rows match the query.

reasons: ad-hoc query outside the scoring methodology
derived from the DB1B 10% ticket sample

caveats: Consumer Airfare Report fares are average one-way fares from the DB1B 10% ticket sample; only the largest domestic (contiguous-US) markets are published.
